ex.en: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
ex.zh: 我們的最終目標是實現世界和平。

ex.en: What is the ultimate purpose of education?
ex.zh: 教育的最終目的究竟是什麼？

ex.en: This is the ultimate guide to Tokyo.
ex.zh: 這是東京旅遊的終極指南。

ex.en: It was the ultimate test of his skills.
ex.zh: 那是對他技能的終極考驗。

ex.en: Her line of reasoning is attractive, but ultimately fallacious.
ex.zh: 她的推論很吸引人，但終究是錯的。

ex.en: Ultimately, the decision is up to you.
The project ultimately cost twice as much as planned.
ex.zh: 這個專案最後花了原本預算的兩倍。

ex.en: Ultraviolet rays can cause skin cancer.
The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
ex.zh: 平流層的臭氧會吸收紫外線。

ex.en: Wear sunglasses to protect your eyes from ultraviolet light.
ex.zh: 戴太陽眼鏡保護眼睛不受紫外線傷害。

ex.en: Too much ultraviolet can damage your skin.
ex.zh: 過量的紫外線會傷害你的皮膚。

ex.en: Sunscreen stops most ultraviolet from reaching your skin.
ex.zh: 防曬乳能阻擋大部分紫外線接觸皮膚。

ex.en: Stress and spicy food made his stomach ulcer worse.
ex.zh: 壓力和辛辣食物讓他的胃潰瘍更嚴重了。

ex.en: I have a painful mouth ulcer, so it hurts to eat.
ex.zh: 我嘴巴破了一個潰瘍，吃東西都會痛。
